lines: New soldiers keep marching to the front.
And the race for Verdel Ridge is over.
The Concord reached one hundred first.
The deciding soldier was Lucien Jro, a field cook. The Medal of Valor is theirs.
The Concord hold the high ground now. A safer week for every one of them.
But the guns of the ridge have turned on the Hegemony. Three nights of shelling begin tonight.
Both sides dug hospitals. Will they pay off? One soldier saw the shells coming.
